## Skills you will gain
Workflow of Machine Learning Projects
AI Terminology
AI Strategy
Workflow of Data Science Projects

AI is not only for engineers. “AI for Everyone”, a non-technical course, will help you understand AI technologies and spot opportunities to apply AI to problems in your own organization. You will see examples of what today’s AI can – and cannot – do. Finally, you will understand how AI is impacting society and how to navigate through this technological change.

If you are a non-technical business professional, “AI for Everyone” will help you understand how to build a sustainable AI strategy. If you are a machine learning engineer or data scientist, this is the course to ask your manager, VP or CEO to take if you want them to understand what you can (and cannot!) do.

## Course Outline

### AI for Everyone
Week 1: What is AI?

Week 2: Building AI Projects

Week 3: Building AI in Your Company

Week 4: AI and Society

## Instructor

### Andrew Ng
Founder, DeepLearning.AI; Co-founder, Coursera

## Learner reviews

## Course Slides
You can download the annotated version of the course slides below.
*Note: The slides might not reflect the latest course video slides. Please refer to the lecture videos for the most up-to-date information. We encourage you to make your own notes.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Who is the course for?

AI For Everyone is truly a course for everyone. Whether you are an engineer, a CEO, a product manager, a marketer, or just someone who wants to understand the terminology of AI, this course will teach you how to navigate the AI-powered future.

What will I learn?

You will learn the meaning of basic AI terms including machine learning, data science, and neural networks. You will also learn what ML and DS project workflows look like and how to implement AI projects in your company. Finally, you will learn about AI’s impact on society.

Are there any prerequisites?

No, you do not need to have any technical or business background prior to taking this course.

How do I take the course?

You can [enroll in AI For Everyone](https://bit.ly/2VQOk7N) on Coursera’s platform. You will watch videos and complete assignments on Coursera as well.

How much does the course cost?

The course costs $49 for 180 days of certificate eligibility.

Can I apply for financial aid?

Yes, Coursera provides financial aid to learners who cannot afford the fee. Apply for it by clicking on the Financial Aid link beneath the “Enroll” button on the left. You’ll be prompted to complete an application and will be notified if you are approved. [Learn more](https://learner.coursera.help/hc/articles/209819033).

Will I receive a certificate at the end of the course?

You will receive a certificate if you pay the $49 course price.

How long is the course?

It typically takes 4 weeks, 2-3 hours per week to complete the course.

- Most accessibility audits cost between $1,250 and $2,750. Per page pricing is $100 to $250 for primary pages or screens and $25 to $100 for light pages or screens.

- WCAG 2.1 AA or WCAG 2.2 AA standard

- We select a representative sample of pages / screens for scope.

- Audits are fully manual evaluations (not automated scans)

- All auditors are certified DHS Trusted Testers

- Many clients add our VPAT service (WCAG edition) for $350 to turn the audit and fixes into an Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR).

- Technical support is $195 per hour

- User testing is $550 per session ($450 with an audit)

- Certification is included at no additional cost, contingent upon conformance.

Full pricing for services is in the table below.

Add the services you want and get an estimate with our [new shopping cart](https://accessible.org/cart).

For a fast estimate, you can also try our [cost calculator](https://accessible.org/cost-calculator/), or email [info@accessible.org](mailto:info@accessible.org) for a custom quote.

Pricing information accurate and updated on October 29, 2026.

## Sections

- [VPAT/ACR](https://accessible.org/pricing/#vpat-acr)

- [Accessibility Certification](https://accessible.org/pricing/#accessibility-certification)

## Accessibility Audit Cost

Accessible.org web accessibility audits cost $100 – $250 per page (or screen) and $25 – $100 for light pages/screens. Our audits follow best practices for ADA and EAA compliance. Our audit price is based on comprehensive manual evaluation using the WCAG 2.1 AA standard (or WCAG 2.2 AA). Audits are conducted in desktop environment with the client option to add mobile.

Our website accessibility audits are fully manual, formal evaluations conducted by technical accessibility experts who evaluate your website or other digital assets against WCAG 2.0 AA, WCAG 2.1 AA, or WCAG 2.2 AA standards.

Scope typically does not include all pages or screens, but rather a representative sample.

We use an automated scan as a review to ensure all issues correctly identified by a scan are included in our final audit report.

All Accessible.org auditors are certified DHS Trusted Testers. The DHS Trusted Tester Process is a manual test approach that aligns with the ICT Testing Baseline, and provides repeatable and reliable conformance test results.

### Digital Assets Audited

Accessible.org can audit all types of digital assets:

- Websites

- Web pages

- Web apps

- Mobile apps

- Platforms

- Dashboards

- Software

- Games

- Widgets

- Elements

- Components

- Portals

- Multimedia Players

### Evaluation Methodology

Accessible.org uses the following methodologies and environments when evaluating your digital asset(s):

- Screen Reader Testing

- Keyboard Testing

- Visual Inspection

- Code Inspection

- Automated Scan:

- AXE

- Color Contrast Analyzer Tool

- Browser Zoom:

- 200%

- 400%

- Assistive Technologies:

- Screen Readers: NVDA, JAWS, and/or VoiceOver.

- Browser Environments:

- Browsers: Chrome and Safari.

- Operating Systems:

- Windows (desktop)

- iOS (mobile)

- Device Environments:

- Audit includes desktop environment with client option to add mobile (iPhone).

By choosing our audit services, you will receive an excellent quality, easy to understand audit report that your team can take action on.

We can add other environments (e.g., MacOS and Android) upon request for an additional fee.

Our website accessibility audit cost breakdown shows you exactly how we determine your final audit price quote.

### Deliverables:

- Technical Audit Report Format: Excel Spreadsheet
- Includes detailed technical findings and specific issues identified during the audit

### Price

$100–$250 per page or screen, $25-$100 for light pages/screens

## VPAT / ACR

VPAT services start at $350 for the WCAG VPAT version. We will fill in and complete a Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) and create a detailed Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) based on our audit. Our ACR creation service is $350 (for the WCAG version) in addition to the price of the audit for your digital asset.

### Other VPAT Editions

- Section 508: $550

- EN 301 549: $650

- INT: $950

This documentation is essential for meeting procurement requirements. We can pause issuance so that your team has a chance to fix issues and we can validate. This results in a cleaner ACR (demonstrating a more accessible product or service) you can deliver to clients.

### Price:

$350 for the WCAG VPAT version.

## Technical Support

Our technical support hours are flexible and can be used for validation of fixes (to ensure the audit issues have been resolved).

Technical support also includes support for any accessibility or implementation questions your team has.

### Support Includes:

- Validation

- Questions Answered

### Price

$195/hour

## Accessibility User Testing Cost

User testing services for website accessibility (and other digital assets) cost $550 per session and are a best practice for ADA compliance. The price of user testing is discounted if you choose Accessible.org for audit and remediation services.

User testing is conducted by an accessibility professional with a disability, is an essential part of ensuring your digital assets are accessible to all users. We offer user testing at a discounted rate when combined with our audit and remediation services.

### Service Details:

- User Testing: Conducted by a professional who is blind or visually impaired, using screen reader assistive technology to evaluate your website or digital asset.

- Deliverable: You will receive a recording of the user testing session upon completion.

### Deliverables:

- Recording of the user testing session upon completion.

- User Testing Attestation

Note : User testing sessions include up to 10 pages or screens with a time duration cap of 30 minutes.

### Price

$550 per session

$450 per session if you choose us for audit services.

### Accessibility Remediation Cost

We will remediate your digital asset at the code level. This means we will fix the technically complex accessibility issues on your website, web app, or mobile app.

To be eligible for remediation, we must 1) audit your digital asset and 2) have full code access. The audit is necessary to ensure we know all accessibility issues that exist (we don’t accept outside audits to uphold quality). Full code access is necessary to ensure we’re able to make all fixes.

We validate our remediation.

#### Service Details:

- Remediation: Conducted by a technical accessibility expert with development experience. All fixed issues are reviewed and validated by auditor.

- Deliverable: You will receive your code remediated digital asset.

#### Remediation Includes:

- Technical code remediation

- Validation of remediation

Note: An audit and full code access is required for remediation.

### Price

$750 – $4,500 for most clients, $100 – $450 per page or screen, depending on volume and complexity.

## Document Remediation Cost

Document accessibility remediation costs start at $4.00 per page. The price of remediating PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, and Excel spreadsheets for WCAG 2.1 AA conformance depends on the document status and project scope.

We will remediate your documents to meet the highest accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 AA and PDF/UA standards. Documents include:

- Microsoft PowerPoint documents

- PDFs

- Microsoft Word documents

- Microsoft Excel spreadsheets

- Canva documents

We will manually test documents and fix accessibility issues according to WCAG 2.1 AA and WCAG 2.2 AA standards and PDF/UA. Each document will meet Section 508 criteria, pass the Adobe Acrobat accessibility check, and be individually tested with screen reader assistive technology.

Minimum order is $250.

### Deliverables

- Documents remediated for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA, PDF/UA conformance and/or Section 508 compliance, passing Adobe Acrobat and assistive technology checks.

- PAC Report for PDFs (where applicable)

### Price

- PDFs start at $4.00/page

- Word Documents start at $7.00/page

- PowerPoints starts at $7.00/page

## Accessibility Certification

Our website accessibility certification documents are provided free of charge ($0.00) as a result of our services. These documents include Accessible.org certification, user testing certification, and a statement of conformance.

Note that to be eligible for a statement of conformance or provider certification, your website or other digital asset must be fully WCAG conformant.

For a statement of partial conformance, your website must be fully WCAG conformant other than content that is outside of your control.

### Certification Includes:

- Statement of conformance

- Statement of partial conformance

- Accessible.org certification

- User testing certification

### Price

$0.00

## Updates for All Services Listed Below

To focus on our most popular services, we no longer offer the following services. We have maintained this information as a resource for those researching service information.

### Content Remediation Cost

Content accessibility remediation costs are project-based. Because the work involved can vary from one project to the next, we provide general rates for each type of content. All content will be remediated to meet WCAG 2.0 AA, WCAG 2.1 AA, and WCAG 2.2 AA standards.

#### Content includes:

- Closed Captions

- Audio Descriptions

- Audio Transcripts

- Text Transcripts

- Text

- Alt Text

Note: Web content varies according to the nature of the content. For example, some alternate videos with audio descriptions are easier to create than others. These prices are to give you an estimate for your expected costs. Contact us for a custom quote. Minimum order of $250 for content remediation.

#### Price

- Alt Text : $2.25 Per Image

- Closed Captions : $2.25 Per minute

- Audio Description : $17.50 per minute for alternative videos with audio descriptions.

- Text Transcripts : $1.50 per minute

- Text : $0.065 per word

Social media accessibility services start at $1,000. Our services follow best practices for ADA compliance including conformance with WCAG 2.1 AA. Social media pricing is based on the scope of your accessibility project.

One option is we will integrate with your social media team to remediate your social media content (text, video, images, and audio) for accessibility on a monthly basis.

This means we will fix all of your content so that it’s ready for publishing. Social media platforms covered include:

- LinkedIn

- YouTube

- Facebook

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a website accessibility audit cost?

Most website accessibility audits range between $1,250 and $2,750. Pricing is $100 to $250 per primary page or screen and $25 to $100 for light pages or screens. Because our audits are custom and fully manual, your final cost depends on scope, status, and complexity.

### How is the audit price determined?

Three factors set the price: scope (the number and type of pages or screens in your representative sample), status (how accessible the asset already is), and complexity (interactive components, dynamic content, and custom widgets). We evaluate a representative sample rather than every page.

### What is the difference between a primary page and a light page?

### How much does an ACR cost?

Most clients choose our WCAG edition VPAT service, which is $350 in addition to the cost of the audit. We complete the Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) and produce a finished Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) based on the audit. Other editions are Section 508 at $550, EN 301 549 at $650, and the INT combined edition at $950.

The different amounts represent the time necessary to fill out the different editions.

### What WCAG standards do you evaluate against?

We evaluate digital assets against WCAG 2.1 AA or WCAG 2.2 AA, and occasionally WCAG 2.0 AA.
